title: Validate warehouse transfer draft line shape and live master references before commitment
description: Stage 3 verified write-validation gap in the inventory document family, the same defect class repaired for sales orders (ERP-422), purchase orders (ERP-426 and ERP-427) and for the sibling stock adjustment document (ERP-355). src/ERP.Api/Controllers/StockTransferController.cs:147-164 Create and :166-211 Update persist the posted StockTransfer and its StockTransferDetails with zero line-shape or live-master validation: Create only authorizes (:152), normalizes numbers (:160) and saves (:162), and Update only checks the Pending status (:180) before replacing every detail (:191-196); neither rejects FromWarehouseId == ToWarehouseId, FromWarehouseId or ToWarehouseId <= 0, a soft-deleted or disabled warehouse, a soft-deleted or disabled product, a non-positive or unrepresentable Quantity, a negative or unrepresentable UnitCost, an empty effective detail list, or duplicate product lines. src/ERP.Application/Services/StockTransferPostingRules.cs exposes only EnsureMenuAuthorizedAsync (:51), IsRelationalProvider (:91) and StockKeys (:102), and src/ERP.Api/Controllers/InventoryDocumentHelper.cs:34-43 WarehouseNameAsync returns an empty string and :49-65 ResolveProductAsync returns caller-supplied fallback text for missing or deleted rows, so drafts silently persist phantom warehouses and products; only Approve (:219-300) re-checks presence (:237-238), distinctness (:239-240), non-empty details (:243-244) and Quantity > 0 (:256-257), leaving malformed drafts readable, submittable and page-visible. Add the same shared draft guard the sibling src/ERP.Api/Controllers/StockAdjustmentController.cs:156-157 and :183-184 already applies (StockAdjustmentPostingRules.EnsureLineShape at :106 and EnsureLiveMasterDataAsync at :134) to StockTransferPostingRules and call it on create and update before the detail replacement, keeping the existing document number generation, Pending status, Normalize totals, UPDLOCK/HOLDLOCK row lock, serializable transaction and approve/reverse semantics unchanged. No new table, column, index or menu. Preserve supported empty draft headers if established; all explicit effective lines require valid positive bounded quantities and nonnegative representable prices/costs. Submit/approval requires nonempty valid lines. Validate calculated line and header amounts against real EF precision/overflow before numbering or writes, not merely each factor separately. Preserve supported repeated product lines and cumulative quantity semantics, do not introduce an arbitrary uniqueness rule. Preserve current business permissions and actor/customer scope; no new grants. Adapt all affected original fixtures with real enabled identities and existing menus/master rows, never remove business assertions or retain null-context/provider/test exceptions. Full original failure logs retained. Explicit test output/TRX/results directories must be .ai/logs/<task> only, never repository-root TestResults. SQL must use exactly (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets before access, never drop/reset. Safe Release restore/build with analyzers and warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine isolated SQL validation; no whole-stage acceptance or production access.
acceptance_criteria: Create and update on /api/inventory/stock-transfers reject, before any StockTransfer or StockTransferDetail write and before consuming a document number, a non-positive FromWarehouseId or ToWarehouseId, an identical FromWarehouseId and ToWarehouseId, a warehouse that does not exist or is soft-deleted or disabled, a detail with a non-positive or EF-unrepresentable Quantity, a detail with a negative or EF-unrepresentable UnitCost, a detail whose ProductId is missing or does not exist or is soft-deleted or disabled, returning the existing controlled validation error codes with zero persisted change; the previously silent empty warehouse name and caller-supplied product fallback text are never treated as proof of a live reference.

Retain every existing stock transfer boundary and contract: authorization stays the existing stock-query menu gate resolved live before any read or write, document numbers still come from IDocumentNumberService, drafts still start Pending with server-computed SortNo and totals, the update path keeps the same UPDLOCK/HOLDLOCK row lock and serializable transaction with whole-document rollback, and approve, reverse, cancel and delete semantics, multi-warehouse deterministic lock ordering and the StockMovements ledger stay unchanged, with no new table, column, index, menu, grant or permission.

Add genuine unit tests and isolated SQL controller tests covering create and update for a missing, zero, deleted and disabled warehouse, the same from and to warehouse, zero and negative quantity, negative unit cost, unrepresentable quantity and cost, missing, deleted and disabled product, repeated product lines with correct cumulative quantities and the permitted flow, asserting zero StockTransfer, StockTransferDetail, StockMovement and document-number change on every rejection; existing StockTransferPostingTests, StockAdjustmentPostingTests, InventoryMovementTests and StockInOutMovementLedgerTests contracts stay green.

Keep the safe Release build with analyzers and warnings-as-errors and the full existing ERP.UnitTests suite green, run genuine SQL only on the isolated localdb NEWERP_AutoAcceptance instance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database that is never dropped or reset, and claim no whole-stage acceptance from a build alone.

Preserve currently supported empty draft headers and repeated product lines; validate every explicitly supplied effective line, and require nonempty valid lines before submit or approval. Numeric validation includes calculated line/header representability and overflow after existing unit normalization. Rejected calls consume no number and change no document/detail/inventory/source rows.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/StockTransferController.cs:147-164 Create (authorize :152, Normalize :160, save :162) and :166-211 Update (Pending check :180, detail replacement :191-196) call no line-shape or live-master validation; src/ERP.Application/Services/StockTransferPostingRules.cs declares only EnsureMenuAuthorizedAsync (:51), IsRelationalProvider (:91) and StockKeys (:102); src/ERP.Api/Controllers/InventoryDocumentHelper.cs:34-43 WarehouseNameAsync returns an empty string for a missing or deleted warehouse and :49-65 ResolveProductAsync returns caller fallback text for a missing product, so no rejection happens; the sibling src/ERP.Api/Controllers/StockAdjustmentController.cs:156-157 and :183-184 does call StockAdjustmentPostingRules.EnsureLineShape (:106) and EnsureLiveMasterDataAsync (:134); Approve re-checks only presence (:237-238), distinctness (:239-240), non-empty details (:243-244) and Quantity > 0 (:256-257); an exact search of .ai/tasks returns no task adding draft validation to StockTransferController or StockTransferPostingRules.
